<DOCSTRING>
Logs whether a user is an adult or a minor based on their age.

@summary Determines if a user is an adult and logs the result.
@description This function checks if the provided user is an adult using the `isAdult` method. If the user is an adult, it logs a message stating the user's name followed by "is adult". If the user is a minor, it logs a message stating the user's name followed by "is minor".
@returns {void} - No value is returned. The function logs the result to the console.
@throws {Error} - This function does not throw any errors.
</DOCSTRING>
